notes: v039 and v040 are underdetermined and resolve to the base; the English matches.

εὐξαίμην ἄν is taken as one unit on the single modal would rather than leaving ἄν unrepresented, which rule 50 names as the recurring failure; giving would to ἄν alone and leaving the optative empty is the competing reading.
said* is folded onto Παῦλος under rule 56, no predicate standing in the clause for it — the contrast with 26:28, where πρός stands and rule 62 applies.
τούς takes that under rule 90, the ASV writing one word for the article-participle pair, which is pronoun and relativizer at once; the second καί at s027 is unrepresented under rule 65.
